objective: Create one dedicated public insurance quote-request page that submits only canonical public quote fields into the retry-safe INS-006I HTTP ingress.

architecture.retrySemantics: The same key is reused for network/server retries while the logical payload is unchanged.
architecture.editSemantics: Any material form edit invalidates the active retry key so the next submission gets a new opaque key.
architecture.successSemantics: HTTP 201 creation and 200 replay are both successful completion states.
architecture.conflictSemantics: HTTP 409 blocks resubmission of the unchanged payload until the visitor materially edits the form.
architecture.privacy: No quote payload is persisted to localStorage or sessionStorage.
architecture.attribution: Landing pathname and recognized UTM parameters are submitted through existing canonical public fields.
architecture.customerIdentity: relationshipId remains server-owned and is never submitted by the browser.
